title.narrative: Olam COVID-19 Smallholder Farmer Livelihood Support Project

description.narrative: The project will help sustain the livelihood of smallholder farmers impacted by COVID-19 in Indonesia, Viet Nam, and PNG by providing working capital financing to Olam International Limited (OIL) and Olam Treasury Private Limited (OTPL) to increase its raw material procurement from these farmers.
